sentences.cn_text: 研究人员提出，从非洲狩猎采集者那里获得的育儿经验可能是培养更快乐孩子的关键。
sentences.en_text: Parenting tips obtained from hunter-gatherers in Africa may be the key to bringing up more contented children, researchers have suggested.

sentences.cn_text: 这一观点基于对博茨瓦纳昆族等社群的研究，在这些社群中，每个孩子都由众多成年人共同照料。
sentences.en_text: The idea is based on studies of communities such as the Kung of Botswana, where each child is cared for by many adults.

sentences.cn_text: 昆族的孩子四岁时就会帮助照顾更小的孩子，而用吊带背负婴儿的「婴儿背带」做法被视为常态。
sentences.en_text: Kung children as young as four will help to look after younger ones and “baby-wearing”, in which infants are carried in slings, is considered the norm.

sentences.cn_text: 剑桥大学进化人类学家尼基尔·乔杜里博士认为，这些被称为「协同育儿」的做法可能会减轻儿童和父母的焦虑。
sentences.en_text: According to Dr Nikhil Chaudhary, an evolutionary anthropologist at Cambridge University, these practices, known as alloparenting, could lead to less anxiety for children and parents.

sentences.cn_text: 儿童精神病学家安妮·斯瓦内普尔博士认为，有办法将这些做法融入西方生活。
sentences.en_text: Dr Annie Swanepoel, a child psychiatrist, believes that there are ways to incorporate them into western life.

sentences.cn_text: 在德国,一项计划将一家养老院与一家托儿所配对。
sentences.en_text: In Germany, one scheme has paired an old people’s home with a nursery.

sentences.cn_text: 养老院的居民帮助照顾孩子,这种安排类似于协同育儿。
sentences.en_text: The residents help to look after the children, an arrangement akin to alloparenting.

sentences.cn_text: 另一项措施可能是鼓励不同年级儿童之间建立友谊,以模仿狩猎采集社群中无人监管的混龄游戏群体。
sentences.en_text: Another measure could be encouraging friendships between children in different school years, to mirror the unsupervised mixed-age playgroups in hunter-gatherer communities.

sentences.cn_text: 在《儿童心理学与精神病学杂志》上发表的一篇论文中,研究人员指出,西方核心家庭是近期出现的产物,背离了进化历史。
sentences.en_text: In a paper published in the Journal of Child Psychology and Psychiatry, researchers said that the western nuclear family was a recent invention which broke with evolutionary history.

sentences.cn_text: 这种向「密集母职叙事」的突然转变——即认为母亲应独自承担育儿责任——很可能是有害的。
sentences.en_text: This abrupt shift to an “intensive mothering narrative”, which suggests that mothers should manage childcare alone, was likely to have been harmful.

sentences.cn_text: 他们写道:「这种叙事可能导致母亲精疲力竭,并产生危险后果。」
sentences.en_text: “Such narratives can lead to maternal exhaustion and have dangerous consequences,” they wrote.

sentences.cn_text: 相比之下,在狩猎采集社会中,父母以外的成年人可以提供近一半的儿童照料。
sentences.en_text: By contrast, in hunter-gatherer societies adults other than the parents can provide almost half of a child’s care.

sentences.cn_text: 此前一项研究考察了刚果民主共和国的埃费人。
sentences.en_text: One previous study looked at the Efé people of the Democratic Republic of Congo.

sentences.cn_text: 研究发现,婴儿到18周大时,平均每天有14名辅助照料者,并且每小时在照料者之间传递8次。
sentences.en_text: It found that infants had an average of 14 alloparents a day by the time they were 18 weeks old, and were passed between caregivers eight times an hour.

sentences.cn_text: 乔杜里表示,与人类进化史的大部分时期相比,如今父母从家庭和社会网络获得的育儿支持更少,但引入更多照料者可以减轻压力和产后抑郁,这可能对儿童的幸福感产生「连锁」效应。
sentences.en_text: Chaudhary said that parents now have less childcare support from family and social networks than during most of humans’ evolutionary history, but introducing additional caregivers could reduce stress and maternal depression, which could have a “knock-on” benefit to a child’s wellbeing.

sentences.cn_text: 出生在狩猎采集社会的婴儿可能有十多名照料者——这与英国托儿所的规定形成鲜明对比,后者要求两到三岁儿童每四人配一名照料者。
sentences.en_text: An infant born to a hunter-gatherer society could have more than ten caregivers — this contrasts starkly to nursery settings in the UK where regulations call for a ratio of one carer to four children aged two to three.

sentences.cn_text: 狩猎采集社会的儿童在混龄游戏群体中通过观察和模仿学习,而研究人员指出,西方的「指导性教学」——要求学生静坐——可能导致注意力缺陷多动障碍等问题。
sentences.en_text: While hunter-gatherer children learnt from observation and imitation in mixed-age playgroups, researchers said that western “instructive teaching”, where pupils are asked to sit still, may contribute to conditions such as attention deficit hyperactivity disorder.

sentences.cn_text: 乔杜里表示,英国应探索让年长子女帮助父母的可能性,这「也可能促进他们自身的社会性发展」。
sentences.en_text: Chaudhary said that Britain should explore the possibility that older siblings helping their parents “might also enhance their own social development.”
